links.outcome: LLM ICD-O-3 coding performance on real-world pathology reports versus need for deployment competence
links.effect: Best exact topography micro-F1 71.6% (Qwen3-235B-A22B); best exact morphology micro-F1 34.7% (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B); performance not sufficient for fully automated use.
links.quote: Although LLMs demonstrate promising capabilities as support systems for expert-guided pathology coding, their performance is not yet sufficient for fully automated, unsupervised use in routine clinical workflows.

links.outcome: Generalization to rare conditions measured by micro- vs macro-average F1 gap
links.effect: Large disparities between micro- and macroaverage F1-scores indicated poor generalization to rare conditions.
links.quote: Large disparities between micro- and macroaverage F1-scores indicated poor generalization to rare conditions.

unlisted_practices: Self-hosting open-source LLMs on private hospital infrastructure for PHI protection
Including anatomic context in prompts to improve topography code extraction

screen.reason: The study evaluates multiple self-hosted open-source LLMs on a retrospective dataset of real-world pathology reports for automated ICD-O-3 coding, focusing on model accuracy/feasibility rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
